reference.limits: Not published on the pages opened. WordPress job board (WP Job Manager pattern): public /feed/ RSS; no developer API. robots.txt blocks Bytespider, PetalBot, YandexBot … with Disallow: / for unlisted agents; the site promotes its own 'Automate your Job Search' (JobCopilot) affiliate. No terms page linked from the home page.

search.note: GET https://euremotejobs.com/wp-json/wp/v2/job-listings: the WP Job Manager job_listing post type through the WordPress REST API posts controller (arguments page, per_page <= 100, search = WordPress full-text search; the route's own schema is listed at that URL). location and remote are not sent (location is post meta / a region taxonomy, not a query argument). title and description are rendered HTML; company is meta._company_name, location meta._job_location, the apply link meta._application and salary meta._job_salary stay in raw.meta. Only published listings are returned; a page past the end answers 400 rest_post_invalid_page_number (upstream_error). This board stores location in the job_listing_region taxonomy (ids in raw.job_listing_region), so location is usually null.

get_posting.note: GET /wp-json/wp/v2/job-listings/<id> with the numeric post id from search; an unknown id answers 404 rest_post_invalid_id (invalid_input).

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify: the WordPress REST API is read publicly and the site offers no job-seeker account API.
not_offered.apply: Applications go to each listing's meta._application (an employer URL or e-mail); the site has no application endpoint.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging endpoint in the site's REST index; only job listings are exposed.
